name: Quiz Web App
desc: This is a college project where users can take a quiz in multiple categories which they can choose, while the admin has a Dashboard to manage the quizzes, categories, and user histories.

name: Web Text Editor
desc: This is a personal project where users can log in with a Google account or a regular email, access their text files and folders, and edit them on the website where they can also download them.

name: Pokemon App
desc: This is a mobile app built with Flutter. It displays Pokemon data fetched from the PokeAPI using GraphQL.
